fix_summary.v3_bug_root_cause: scripts/run_lp_long_horizon_readonly_stage_once.sh interpolated bash ${REAL_GATE_PASS} (lowercase 'true'/'false') directly into unquoted Python heredoc dict values and ternary expressions. Python interpreted these as bare names, raising NameError.
fix_summary.fix_strategy: Convert all Python heredocs to quoted form (<<'PYEOF_...') and pass all bash values as environment variables. Python reads os.environ values (integers + strings) and computes any boolean comparison in Python with proper bool type. The aggregate block writes a real JSON boolean to aggregate_summary.json; the finalize + fallback blocks read that JSON file via json.loads.

lines_fixed.line_171_223_trap_block: now uses <<'PYEOF_TRAP' quoted heredoc; bash values exported as TRAP_* env vars; Python computes runtime_valid with int>=int comparison; no bash boolean interpolation
lines_fixed.line_331_415_aggregate_block: now uses <<'PYEOF_AGG' quoted heredoc; DATA_DIR / LOG_DIR / STAGE_NAME / RUN_ID / LOOP_COUNT / SLEEP_SECONDS / ELAPSED_MIN / DURATION_HOURS / TOLERANCE_MIN / GATE_DECISION / REPORT_DIR / SESSION exported; runtime_valid computed in Python; aggregate_summary.json now contains a real JSON bool for actual_runtime_valid_for_<STAGE>_gate
lines_fixed.line_421_497_finalize_block: now uses <<'PYEOF_FINAL' quoted heredoc; reads aggregate_summary.json via json.loads (proper bool); computes status / data_quality / recommended_next_stage in Python from the JSON bool
lines_fixed.line_495_569_fallback_block: now uses <<'PYEOF_FALLBACK' quoted heredoc; reads aggregate_summary.json via json.loads, falls back to ELAPSED_MIN / DURATION_HOURS / TOLERANCE_MIN env vars if JSON missing; runtime_valid is a real Python bool

v3_12h_raw_finalizer_status: preserved unchanged (FAIL with default-zeros pool_snapshot_rows=0); corrected verdict already covers the data; the fix is forward-looking so future 6h/12h/24h/48h/72h/7d runs produce a non-corrupted raw FINAL_VERDICT

future_stages_unblocked.future_raw_finalize_works: With this fix, future 6h/12h/24h/48h/72h/7d stage runners will produce a raw FINAL_VERDICT.json with proper bool fields and correct row counts. corrected verdicts are no longer required to disambiguate raw vs corrected.
future_stages_unblocked.no_more_corrected_verdict_needed: If the supervisor finalize block runs successfully, FINAL_VERDICT.json is written with status=PASS/FAIL based on actual gate. If it fails, the fallback writes CORRECTED_FINAL_VERDICT_FALLBACK.json with status=WARN. Both paths produce a useful verdict.
future_stages_unblocked.12h_retry_safety: 12h retry (LP_LONG_HORIZON_READONLY_CONTINUOUS_12H_REAL_UNIVERSE_RETRY_REQUEST_V1) can now produce a non-corrupted raw FINAL_VERDICT. combined with the prior collector fix (--pool-universe), the 12h retry will write a real-pool-universe based FINAL_VERDICT with proper bool gate.

recommended_next_stage_rationale: 本 stage 已修 supervisor finalize bug (Python heredoc lowercase true/false interpolation). 4 个 block (trap / aggregate / finalize / fallback) 全部用 quoted heredoc + env vars, Python 端用 bool() 显式转换, aggregate_summary.json 写真 JSON bool. dry-run 用 12h checkpoint fixture 验证成功 (status=PASS, runtime=720, pool_rows=5, 12 ckpts). 下一步推荐 LP_LONG_HORIZON_REAL_POOL_UNIVERSE_COVERAGE_EXPAND_V1 (5 协议 EVM/Meteora coverage fix), 不要马上用 5 个真实池重跑 12h. 12h retry 仍需 3 项: 5 协议 coverage fix + 用户单独审批 + (本 stage 已修 finalize, 不再是 blocker).
